result.title: Turning Multi-Agent Communication into Token-Level Credit with On Policy Self Distillation
result.summary: Reinforcement learning improves problem solving in large language model multi-agent systems. Existing approaches overlook communication knowledge or compress it into scalar rewards, leaving coarse credit with little guidance on which decisions each agent should reinforce or revise. OPSD4MAS converts future communication into fine-grained token-level credit through On Policy Self Distillation (OPSD). An external model extracts facts and assesses their trajectory relations for coarse-grained filtering, followed by fine-grained leave-one-out filtering of target-token influence against agent-wise outcome advantages. The fact-conditioned policy supplies token-level credit, combined with GRPO through a linearly annealed joint objective. Our method improves mathematical pass@4 over GRPO by up to 20.00 percentage points. Ablations support complete filtering, while frozen-history injection diagnostics support fact utility. Together, these results support combining agent-level outcome guidance with communication-derived token-level credit. Code is available at https://github.com/Camel-Prince/OPSD4MAS.

AI.brief_summary: OPSD4MAS 将多智能体 LLM 强化学习中的未来通信内容转化为 token 级信用：先用外部模型抽取事实并粗筛其轨迹关系，再做 leave-one-out 细粒度筛选，与 GRPO 通过线性退火联合优化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「将中间通信内容转为 token 级信用并做贡献筛选」的做法，可能为 LVR 中重构轨迹与答案之间的贡献分配、以及视觉证据筛选提供可核查的监督线索，但该工作本身是纯文本多智能体场景，与视觉推理的距离需进一步确认。
